{{Quote|It was the power of mind that made this victory possible. Plus a little help from a friend.|Kit Fisto|<ref name="GoD" />}}
A '''battle''' was fought in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. After [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] warriors captured Rishi's [[Exonium/Legends|Exonium]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] division [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]] to repel the invaders. Without a [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General's]] leadership, Green Company's [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] could not defeat the Geonosians, who had heavily entrenched in the mines. However, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] soon arrived and formulated an attack plan, which involved him using his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to deflect [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone sharpshooter]] [[Cooker|2242's]] [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots into the enemy. Using this strategy, Fisto and 2242 managed to [[Death/Legends|kill]] all Geonosians who guarded the canyon leading to the mines, allowing Green Company to initiate an assault on the mines themselves.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Created this army for warfare did you not? I put your warriors to their purpose. They failed because their power is not great enough.|Gwarrk, to Kit Fisto|<ref name="GoD" />}}
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in order to get the [[Exonium/Legends|Exonium]] [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] needed for their [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapons]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] and captured its Exonium [[Mining/Legends|mines]]. In response, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] division [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]] to repel the Separatists and protect the native [[Rishii/Legends|Rishii]]. Since no [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] was initially available to lead the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], and because the Separatist's elite [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] warriors had heavily entrenched in the mines, the clones were ordered to await [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto's]] arrival before attempting an attack. In the meantime, the Rishii [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] [[Gwarrk]] assumed command of Green Company.<ref name="GoD" />

Gwarrk, however, was desperate to reclaim the Exonium, which was needed for the Rishii to prepare food. To this end, he ordered the Republic forces to initiate an attack. The clones followed Gwarrk's order but faced heavy opposition from the Geonosians that guarded the canyon leading to the entrance of the mines. At that moment, however, Fisto finally arrived and ordered all [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to pull back. Gwarrk insisted on another direct assault, but Fisto told him that it would only result in the Republic's defeat. Instead, the Jedi Master ordered the clones' [[Unidentified clone trooper commander (Rishi)|commander]] to provide him with the [[Company/Legends|company's]] best [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]] and keep the rest of the troops ready for battle.<ref name="GoD" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|This Jedi is very powerful&mdash;or very dead!|Gwarrk, on Kit Fisto|<ref name="GoD" />}}
[[File:Rishi_mines_attack.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Clone troopers and Rishii warriors attack the mines.]]
Fisto headed toward the canyon, while [[Clone sharpshooter/Legends|clone sharpshooter]] [[Cooker|2242]], nicknamed "Cooker" for his tendency to hit the Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in the [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]], took position above it. After Cooker had informed Fisto that he would have no line of sight with the enemy from that position, the Jedi Master finally revealed to the clone all of his plan's details, which involved Cooker aiming for Fisto's shoulder and firing continuously. As the Geonosians attacked Fisto with [[Geonosian sonic blaster/Legends|sonic blasters]], the Jedi Master ordered Cooker to open fire and&mdash;using a combination of his acrobatic skills and [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]&mdash;started moving throughout the canyon, deflecting Cooker's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots into the Separatists with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="GoD" />

Seeing Fisto fighting the enemy alone, Green Company's [[Commander/Legends|commander]] ordered the clone troopers to board their [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]] and head out to assist the Jedi. By that moment, however, all Geonosians in the canyon had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Fisto's and Cooker's combined efforts. Fisto then noticed the massive doors to the mines opening and hoped that this meant a surrender. This proved not to be the case, as the Separatists revealed an [[LR1K sonic cannon/Legends|LR1K sonic cannon]] and attacked Fisto with it, knocking him to the ground. At that moment, Cooker contacted Fisto, asking the Jedi to stay down. Demonstrating his sniping skills, Cooker fired a single shot that destroyed the cannon. The Republic forces&mdash;along with some of the Rishii warriors&mdash;then arrived and attacked the mines, forcing the remaining Geonosians to flee.<ref name="GoD" />

Afterward, Gwarrk acknowledged that Fisto was very powerful, to which the Jedi replied that two factors had made this victory possible&mdash;the power of mind and Cooker's help.<ref name="GoD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Rishi first appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] [[The Gauntlet of Death|''The Clone Wars: The Gauntlet of Death'']], written by [[Henry Gilroy]], illustrated by [[Ramón Pérez|Ramón K. Pérez]], and published by [[Dark Horse Comics]] for [[Free Comic Book Day]]<ref name="GoD" /> on [[May 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="Preview">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/16-214/Free-Comic-Book-Day-2009-Star-Wars-The-Clone-Wars-DH-All-Ages-Split-Issue|text=Free Comic Book Day 2009 Star Wars: The Clone Wars/DH All Ages Split Issue}}</ref>
